Name: Pridified Valley - Pride Decorations for AT
Author: Lycanthropire
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/RmaxW5A.png[/img]
[line]
[/center]
[center]I am a bit late to the party, but only because I wanted to create something to share with you all that was not
only made from scratch, but something I could [i]genuinely [/i]be proud of putting out into the community.

I poured my heart into perfecting every one of these sprites, because it's no less than you all deserve.
The Stardew Valley community has been one of the sweetest, most welcoming and diverse places I have ever had the
pleasure of being a part of, and I hope this mod brings you all as much joy as you've brought me over the years.
If you're reading this, I love you, and [i]you belong[/i]. Happy Pride, my friend!
[line]
[b][size=4][u]INSTALLATION:[/u][/size][/b]

✧ Be sure you have the most up-to-date version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]!
✧ Download the .zip file
✧ Unzip the .zip file using your preferred program (WinZip, 7Zip, etc.)
✧ Drag and drop the unzipped [u][AT] Pridified Valley[/u] folder into your Mods folder
✧ You're done! You can access the textures by using the Paint Bucket (available at Robin's) on any of the supported items.
[line]

[size=4][b][u]SUPPORTED ITEMS:[/u][/b][/size]

✧ Crab Pots ✧
(Floating Candle Boats)

✧ Wood, Stone, Iron and Hardwood Fences ✧
(Ribbon Banners)

✧ Wood and Iron Lampposts ✧
(Star Lamps)

✧ Wood, Gravel, Crystal, Cobblestone and Steeping Stone Paths ✧
(Small Ground Flags)

✧ Wood and Stone Signs ✧
(Standing Banners)

✧ Regular and Heavy Tappers ✧
(Beaded Hearts)

✧ Torches and Spirit Torches* ✧
(Memorial Candles)
[line]

[b][u][size=4]PERMISSIONS:[/size][/u][/b]

As an extra special treat to you all, this mod has (almost) entirely open permissions!
You must still credit me, and link back to this mod so others can find it.

[color=#6aa84f][b][u]You MAY:
[/u][/b]
✧ Create additional pride textures using mine as a base.
(I tried to include as many identities as I could, but I know I still missed some!)

✧ Create a furniture version of this mod for use with Content Patcher.
(I was going to do this myself, but I ran out of steam...^^')

✧ Use individual assets from this mod as decoration for your NPC's rooms, events, etc.

✧ Use the assets from this mod to create Pride-themed festivals, maps, events, etc.

✧ Desaturate, tweak, and redistribute my sprites to fit in better with major recolors.
(Please add my mod as a dependency for yours, if you do this!)

[b] ✧ Basically, as long as your intentions are good and you credit/link back, you're fine![/b][/color]

[color=#ff7700][u][b]You MAY [i]NOT[/i]:[/b]
[/u]
✧ Do [i]not[/i] de-pride-ify these assets.
[size=1](You may create additional flags/recolors that are LGBTQ+ related, but please [i]do not [/i]use them for
national or political flags, and do not recolor them to be specifically non pride-themed.)[/size]

✧ Do NOT feed my assets through AI.
[size=1](All sprite edits must be done by a human, using image editing software like GIMP, Aesprite, PhotoShop, etc.)[/size]

✧ Do NOT use AI when coding your mod, with intent to use my assets.
[size=1](If you plan to use AI for your coding, and think you have a [/size][i][size=1][u]legitimate reason[/u][/size][/i][size=1] for doing so, you must contact me for written permission first[/size][i][size=1], [/size][/i][size=1]before using these assets.)[/size][/color]

[color=#a61c00][b]The open permissions above this section DO NOT exempt you from these restrictions.
You [i]will [/i]be reported on the grounds of theft if you are found to be disrespecting these rules.
Thank you for your cooperation![/b][/color]
[line]

[b][u][size=4]SPECIAL THANKS:[/size][/u][/b]

✧ To my girlfriend, for listening to my endless jabbering, and for providing lots of encouragement.
✧ To my boyfriend, for the same reasons as above, and [i]also[/i] for giving me the idea for the floating candles in paper boats!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M4k6jPc.png[/img]
✧ To PeacefulEnd, for providing Alternative Textures, the framework this mod uses to function.
✧ To Pathoschild, for SMAPI, without which modding Stardew would not be possible.
✧ To ConcernedApe, for creating a game with so much heart, and for actively encouraging the modding aspect of the game.

✧ To YOU!
The encouragement, comments, endorsements and kudos that I've gotten from you all,
both recently and in the past, are what really inspired me to make this. I wouldn't be here without you!

Thank you~


[img]https://i.imgur.com/U0OkxzR.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
SURPRISE![/center]
[center][spoiler]There's some optional bonus textures that have been set up to work with the Dark Sign!
[size=2](You can obtain the recipe for Dark Sign by reaching 3+ hearts with Krobus.)

They are repeats of the beaded hearts (tappers), plus a version of the standing banners (signs) without the signpost.
These have been [i]specifically designed[/i] for use with Anything Anywhere, so you can make it look like they're hanging on
walls, buildings, cliffs, etc. You can use them [i]without [/i]Anything Anywhere, but they may look funny just floating in midair. Lol

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SpcfCkH.gif[/img]

This mod works [i]perfectly fine[/i] without Anything Anywhere, you just won't be able
to get the Dark Signs as close to other objects as you could otherwise.

I will not provide additional support or answer questions regarding using Anything Anywhere.
Use it, and these bonus textures for the Dark Sign, at your own discretion.

~Skye[/size][/spoiler]
[/center]

Downloads.Description:
Please be sure you have the latest update for Alternative Textures installed!
Unzip, then drag and drop this mod into your Mods folder.
Purchase a Paint Bucket from Robin, and use it on the supported objects to pride-ify your valley!

Manifest.Name: (AT) Pridified Valley
Manifest.Description: Adds many pride-themed decoration options for fences, tappers, signs and more! Happy Pride!
Manifest.Author: Lycanthropire
